name: What is the process for custom stair trim design and installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for custom stair trim design and installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for custom stair trim begins with a detailed consultation to understand your vision and assess your staircase. We discuss material options, profiles, and finishes to create a design that complements your home. Once the design is finalized, our skilled craftsmen meticulously measure, cut, and fit each piece of trim on-site. This careful approach ensures a seamless and precise installation, particularly important for achieving a high-quality finish on unique staircases found in homes across Eagle and Kuna. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom stair trim design and installation involves an initial consultation to discuss options, followed by precise on-site measurement, cutting, and fitting by skilled craftsmen.
